messages:
mika: Pushed an alternate design for the API tokens page where each token is a compact card (chip-like) with three affordances: details, copy icon, and overflow. aim: denser list but explicit actions. attaching image.

ash: Nice. Question: what's the keyboard pattern? chips are visually small and we should avoid accidental clipboard copies.

mika: Plan: Tab to token card (entire card focusable), Enter opens details modal. Within card, Tab goes to copy icon then overflow menu. Copy should not be the default on Enter to avoid accidents.

cora: Love that. Also propose a tiny scope badge on the card (lock icon) that reveals a short human summary on hover/focus: "Read: buckets, Write: models". No raw JSON.

design-bot: Accessibility guidance: 1) copy button must have aria-label "Copy key to clipboard"; 2) copy action should announce "Key copied" via aria-live polite (do not include the secret); 3) reveal secret must be a role=dialog with focus trap and require a confirm action to actually show the secret.

lina: Microcopy suggestion for revoke: change label from "Revoke" to "Disable key" and offer "Permanently delete" only inside advanced actions. This reduces user panic. Also include a one-line explanation under the primary CTA.

ben: For rotate, operations want a short grace/cancel window. Suggest: click rotate -> show inline pending pill "Rotation pending — cancel" for 8s, then open confirm modal to finalize. That prevents accidental mass rotates.

mika: Good point. Also, undo behavior after disable should be an accessible toast with an "Undo" button (role=alert, keyboard-focusable) and a 6s default window. Do not include key text in any toast.

ash: Bulk actions edge-case: if some tokens are mid-rotation, bulk disable modal should list conflicts and allow per-token override checkboxes. Don't just skip them silently.

cora: Tooltip copy: avoid technical terms. Instead of "scopes: read:files" show "Read files" and link to scope docs. Also truncate long scope lists but allow full view in details modal.

design-bot: Implementation nits: ensure copy icon target is at least 24px visual and 44x44 touch area, even in compact mode. When chips wrap, overflow menu must anchor at end of card and not float unpredictably.

lina: Empty state draft: "No API tokens yet. Create one to start using Redwood from your app." Primary CTA: "Create token". Secondary: "How scopes work". Add keyboard hint: press C.

mika: Action items: @ben add pending-rotation placeholder with fixed height to avoid layout shifts, @ash wire keyboard order so Enter opens details not copy, @lina send two tone options for disable/delete copy, @cora make scope-summary tooltip. I'll follow up with an updated proto tomorrow. :thumbsup:
